label: Windfall island parts
about: A recipe, not game data: neutral ids, our own words, and references into the game (the room archive, its background models and nodes, a room-local volume, the collision group names). The pieces are built from the player's own game files into the player's model cache.

memory.measured: game heap of the set archive and its models once a room uses it, measured with WWHD_MOD_ACTOR_HEAPS=1 (US game, 2026-10-19); each placement adds its instance
